description: Execute only the four WP15-D2 qualified comparison families and emit member-level descriptive rows with family-specific allowed fields. The output is a pipeline-validation dataset, not comparative or publication evidence.
analysis_unit_rule: Within a family, treatment is the analysis-unit identifier. Multiple policy variants for the same treatment remain separate member rows but share one analysis unit and must not be counted as independent replicates.

baseline_execution.oracle_rule: Every baseline member must match its retained catalog alignment, joint-state when declared, and outcome oracle before projection.

denominator_policy.member_row: One executed source member retained in the derived dataset.
denominator_policy.analysis_unit: One treatment within one comparison family; policy variants share the treatment analysis unit.
denominator_policy.family_coverage_denominator: Unique treatment analysis units expected by the qualified family definition.

projection_policy.allowed_fields_source: The allowed_fields array of each qualified family in the WP15-D2 matrix.
projection_policy.blocked_field_behavior: Omit every field not explicitly allowed by the family from the member-level projection.
projection_policy.alignment_rule: Derive alignment_class and never expose raw epoch-bearing alignment as a cross-treatment comparison field.
projection_policy.diagnostic_family_behavior: Do not execute or emit diagnostic-only families in the derived comparison dataset.
